Nursing Officer 12th Any relevant field Madhyapradesh 18 - 40 45% General, OBC, SC, ST Pursue a rewarding career in healthcare with our organization. We're seeking dedicated professionals who have completed their 10+2 Intermediate Exam with a focus on Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. A Bachelor of Science in Nursing or Post-B.Sc Nursing degree with a minimum of 45% marks (40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates) is required. Additionally, registration with the MP Nursing Council or a Diploma in Pharmacy with State Pharmacy Council registration is necessary. Sister Tutor 12th Any relevant field Madhyapradesh 18 - 40 35% General, OBC, SC, ST Pursue a rewarding career in nursing with a strong foundation in science. We seek candidates who have cleared their 12th standard exam with a focus on Physics, Chemistry, and Biology. A Bachelor of Science in Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing degree, coupled with at least one year of hands-on experience, is essential. Additionally, registration with the Madhya Pradesh Nursing Council is mandatory. For specific eligibility criteria, please refer to the official notification, which outlines post-wise requirements in detail.
